title: Multi language code extractor uses pluggable backend registry with web tree sitter pinned to 0.20.8 for grammar ABI match evidence chunk 3
summary: Extraction uses typed AST descent (not external .scm files). Per-language call nodes differ: call_expression (Go/Rust/C/C++), call (Python), method_invocation with a name field (Java) — collectCalls handles all three. C/C++ function names have no name field; they are dug out of nested declarators (function_definition.declarator -> function_declarator -> identifier, through pointer/reference/parenthesized wrappers). Kind mapping adds struct/interface/enum beyond the JS function/class/method/arrow set (Rust trait -> interface; Go/Rust/C/C++ struct -> struct; enum -> enum). Exported heuristics: Go capitalized, Rust pub, Java public, C/C++ all top-level true, Python all true. New test code-extract-multilang.test.js: 49/49 (per-language fixture + mixed babel+tree-sitter dispatch in one repo). Windows note: emscripten WASM keeps async handles open, so the test sets process.exitCode instead of process.exit() to avoid a libuv UV_HANDLE_CLOSING assertion.
